evals.name: bug-fix-pr-and-commit
evals.prompt: Write a PR title, PR summary, and commit message for this change: after loading cluster nodes from a local file, the parser retained each node's address but discarded its node ID. Matching then fell back to IP and port, which fails when the node listens on 0.0.0.0 but clients see 127.0.0.1. The change now assigns the parsed ID. Before the fix, CLUSTER NODES omitted the myself flag after restart; afterward it includes myself. Tests covering reload and node matching pass. Related issue: #1381.
evals.expected_output: A concise fix-oriented PR title; a PR summary that connects prior behavior, root cause, before/after symptom, corrected behavior, passing tests, and #1381 without inventing details; and a commit message with a subject of at most 70 characters, a blank line, and body prose wrapped at about 72 characters.
assertions: PR title names the node ID reload or matching fix and is at most 70 characters
PR summary explains why IP and port fallback fails for 0.0.0.0 versus 127.0.0.1
PR summary includes the before/after myself behavior and references #1381
Commit subject is at most 70 characters and has no trailing period
Commit body is separated from the subject by a blank line and wraps near 72 characters
No tests or implementation details are invented

evals.name: small-change-commit-only
evals.prompt: Write only a commit message. The change corrects the README link from docs/setup.mdx to docs/setup.md. There is no behavior change and no test was run.
evals.expected_output: Only a concise commit message. A subject-only message is sufficient; it must not claim tests, behavior changes, or broader documentation work.
assertions: Output contains only the requested commit message
Subject is at most 70 characters and has no trailing period
No test result or behavior change is invented

evals.name: repository-template-takes-precedence
evals.prompt: Draft a PR title and summary for a repository whose CONTRIBUTING.md requires titles beginning with [storage] and a PR body with Motivation, Changes, and Testing sections. The patch adds a timeout to snapshot uploads so stalled requests release their worker. An integration test that holds the server response open now confirms the request times out and the worker accepts the next upload.
evals.expected_output: A title beginning with [storage], followed by the required Motivation, Changes, and Testing sections. The prose should explain the stalled-worker problem, timeout behavior, and observed integration test without adding unrelated sections.
assertions: Summary contains Motivation, Changes, and Testing sections
Summary explains the problem, change, and verified result
No commit message or empty section is included
